expert.rationale: Level 2 (rubric anchor: Purpose is stated; the profile's intended feelings are reflected on some screens or in some copy but not in the main flow.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Welcome states the purpose plainly and the dashboard reads calm and data-first. The entry contradicts itself: sign-in offers 'Get started free' though sign-up is closed (the route redirects to /login), and the welcome page says 17 engines while the dashboard says 13 can run.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Some deliberate choices are visible but they are not applied consistently across the main screens.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Teal, gold, mono labels and a node motif are deliberate on welcome, login and dashboard. Team, profile and token pages are Jetstream defaults (light panels, grey text) inside the dark shell. No DESIGN.md records the identity.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Main tasks can be completed, but several screens carry unclear actions, long forms or avoidable memory demands.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Dashboard opens with one summary line and grouped metric tiles; only two nav items. 116 functional text elements render under 11px (0.55-0.7rem mono labels) and many panels stack on one page. Search with real data not exercised.

Level 1 (rubric anchor: The main screens work but spacing, alignment, type or states are visibly inconsistent.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Desktop dashboard is consistent. At 375px the 264px sidebar never collapses (dashboard overflows by 78px, team pages by 105px, content about 110px wide). Reduced motion covers 3 of 29 motion declarations.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Claims and data handling are mostly honest; some states or notices are vague or incomplete.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Good: every seeded tile says DEMO DATA, freshness is shown, unconnected platforms are listed. Weak: '17 engines' versus 13 able to run; closed sign-up still advertised; the app layout loads the Tailwind CDN and avatars from third parties at run time.

Level 1 (rubric anchor: The main flow is completable but with serious barriers (contrast, labels, focus) in several places.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed.
